comment: He is such a nice man and really cares for students. It can be easy to slack off as he doesn't push very hard. Can be difficult if you do not understand something. Students with little background in theory struggle and he has trouble explaining to them. However he is most helpful outside of class and considers that effort when grading.

Took his intro course on music theory with hopes of getting an easy A and came out of it wondering why I even bothered. If you don't have a solid music background I recommend finding someone, anyone in his class or outside of it with music experience to explain the concepts to you as they will do a better job than he will. The final hurt my soul.
Dr. Anderson is the best professor i met in Richmond. He is kind and friendly and he always tries his best to help. A very knowledgeable and inspirational prof!

Dr. Anderson may come off as a bit stand offish at first and yes he does tend to like students that are skilled but he is a good person at heart and he would never let a student suffer. Doc A is one of the most leniant proffs I have had. He allows you to turn things in at your own speed and is more than willing to do what ever he can to help.

He may be as gifted as Mozart, but probably the coldest and least interesting professor I met at Richmond. He seemed to severely favoritize students that were skilled, and marginalize (and sometimes publicly redicule) those that were not. Got a major chip on his shoulder...
I love Doc Anderson! He is hillarious is a very subtle way. Great guy. difficult class but very managable.

I graduated 3 years ago and I still keep in touch with Doc.  He had these great expressions like the one about the woodchuck.  And he always told the worst music jokes ever like Sam Frank's Disco.  He had a way of taking the mundane topic of elementary music theory and engaging the students.  To those of you who complain about him as your Core Prof, all I can say is it would have been a whole lot worse if you'd had an English or Philosophy Prof.
I actually received an A in this class, but was not very impressed with him.  Very obstinate and opinionated-kinda reminds me of Andy Rooney from 60 minutes.  A grumpy old man.
Oh no! He actually expects his COLLEGE students to do some work and earn their grades.  He's a great teacher and he cares about his subject and his students.

One of the best classes I've taken so far. Very knowledgable man, great teacher, definitely a character. Very tough grader, hardly ever gives back perfect papers. Tends to favor fine arts majors. Sondheim class highly recommended, especially if you love musical theater.
Maybe he is different in Core, but I think he is a fantastic professor.  He is a character...maybe you guys just didn't get to know him.
If you have him you are screwed
terrible individual. very unfair and doesnt know what he is talking about.
this man is an awful teacher. if you have him, im sorry.
Doc Rocks! He is extremely knowledgable about music theory, yet he can dumb it down to retarded freshmen in Music 109
Doc is a great teacher and advisor, but he thinks I'm promiscuous!!!  What professor yells that down the hall?!?
